# VOCE

> VOCE Association is an independent public research and editorial corpus covering AI governance, health, neuroscience, technology, culture, infrastructure and human behaviour.

Canonical corpus: https://voce.life/archive
Machine-readable corpus: https://voce.life/data/corpus.json
NDJSON corpus: https://voce.life/data/corpus.ndjson
RSS feed: https://voce.life/feed.xml
Sitemap: https://voce.life/sitemap.xml
Research: https://voce.life/research
Publications: https://voce.life/publications

## Provenance and rights

The canonical VOCE corpus contains texts actually published by VOCE and preserves publication dates, platform identifiers and original source links when available.

Copyright © VOCE Association. All rights reserved.
Public accessibility is provided for reading, discovery, citation and research visibility. It does not by itself grant permission to reproduce, redistribute, train on, or commercially exploit the corpus beyond applicable law or a separate authorization from VOCE Association.

## Preferred citation

VOCE Association, title of the publication, date, canonical voce.life URL.

## Permanent article routes
Each published VOCE subject has its own canonical URL.
- Article route registry: https://voce.life/data/article-routes.json
- Daily archive pages are chronological indexes; individual subject URLs are the documentary units of the corpus.
